## Approach

For this assignment, I'm reusing the listener ratings data I collected for
the SQL and R assignment (five people rating six Strokes tracks from
*Reality Awaits*). My plan is to implement the Global Baseline Estimate
algorithm: combine the overall average rating across everyone and every
song with how far each individual listener and each individual song
tend to deviate from that average, to predict the two ratings that are
actually missing from my data.

The main thing to get right is making sure every average is calculated
only from actual ratings, excluding the missing ones, instead of
treating a missing rating as a zero which would badly skew the
averages downward
